ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky weaponized-LNK → mshta/PowerShell download cradle (BabyShark/ReconShark delivery)
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's signature initial-access chain where a spearphished archive/LNK masquerading as a policy paper or interview request is double-clicked from explorer.exe, spawning mshta.exe or powershell.exe with an obfuscated base64/download-cradle command line. This parent→interpreter→download pattern is the consistent first stage for APT43's BabyShark, AppleSeed and ReconShark families against NK-focused think tanks and academics.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name=explorer.exe OR Processes.parent_process_name=mshta.exe OR Processes.parent_process_name=wscript.exe OR Processes.parent_process_name=cscript.exe) (Processes.process_name=mshta.exe OR Processes.process_name=powershell.exe OR Processes.process_name=pwsh.exe OR Processes.process_name=wscript.exe OR Processes.process_name=cscript.exe OR Processes.process_name=rundll32.exe) AND (Processes.process=*FromBase64String* OR Processes.process=*DownloadString* OR Processes.process=*DownloadFile* OR Processes.process=*-enc* OR Processes.process=*-EncodedCommand* OR Processes.process=*Invoke-Expression* OR Processes.process=*IEX* OR Processes.process=*mshta*http* OR Processes.process=*WindowStyle*Hidden* OR Processes.process=*.lnk*) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","-enc","-EncodedCommand","Invoke-Expression","IEX","WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","javascript:","vbscript:",".lnk","http://","https://")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                                  // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentName in~ ("explorer.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where ChildName in~ ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("FromBase64String","DownloadString","DownloadFile","-enc","-EncodedCommand","Invoke-Expression","IEX","WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","javascript:","vbscript:",".lnk","http://","https://")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky LNK-Spawned Scripting Engine With Download Cradle
id: 2f6c4f1e-9c3a-4b8e-a1d2-7e5c9b0f3a21
status: experimental
description: Detects Kimsuky/APT43 initial-access chain where explorer.exe (LNK double-click) or a script host spawns mshta/powershell with obfuscation or a network download cradle.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1027
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - '-enc'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'WindowStyle Hidden'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
      - '.lnk'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Software deployment scripts launched from desktop shortcuts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe) @Image:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\Rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe) @CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *-enc* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *javascript\:* OR *vbscript\:* OR *.lnk* OR *http*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|mshta|wscript|cscript)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(mshta|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)(FromBase64String|DownloadString|DownloadFile|-enc|-EncodedCommand|Invoke-Expression|IEX|WindowStyle\\s+Hidden|javascript:|vbscript:|\\.lnk|https?://)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The explorer.exe→(mshta|powershell)→download-cradle/base64 chain is Kimsuky's distinctive packaging across BabyShark, AppleSeed and ReconShark, where targets are lured into opening a disguised LNK or HTA. Pairing the LNK-double-click parent context with both a scripting/proxy-exec child AND an obfuscation/network indicator is far tighter than a generic 'powershell -enc' rule and maps directly to G

_field_issues.message: `Za` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.
`Decoded` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents. Did you mean `DeviceId`?

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (TA427/APT43) post-phish mailbox forwarding rule for covert email exfiltration
ucs.description: Hunts Kimsuky's hallmark email-collection objective: after credential-phishing an academic, journalist or NK-policy target, the actor logs into the cloud mailbox and creates a hidden inbox/forwarding rule (often forwarding to an external address or auto-deleting security notices) to silently exfiltrate correspondence. TA427's mission is intelligence collection from email, making mailbox-rule creation a high-value, actor-aligned signal.
ucs.splunk: `o365_management_activity` (Operation="New-InboxRule" OR Operation="Set-InboxRule" OR Operation="Set-Mailbox") | spath input=Parameters | eval ForwardTo=coalesce('Parameters{}.Name', ForwardTo) | search (Parameters=*ForwardTo* OR Parameters=*ForwardAsAttachmentTo* OR Parameters=*RedirectTo* OR Parameters=*DeleteMessage* OR Operation="Set-Mailbox") | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Operation) as Operation values(Parameters) as Parameters values(ClientIP) as src_ip by UserId | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox")
| extend Raw = tostring(RawEventData)
| where Raw has_any ("ForwardTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo","RedirectTo","DeleteMessage","ForwardingSmtpAddress","MoveToFolder")
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, AccountId, ActionType,
          IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP, UserAgent, ObjectName, Raw
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
| where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox")
| extend Params = tostring(Parameters)
| where Params has_any ("ForwardTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo","RedirectTo","DeleteMessage","ForwardingSmtpAddress","MoveToFolder")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP, ClientInfoString, Parameters, OriginatingServer
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky Suspicious Mailbox Forwarding/Inbox Rule Creation
id: 8b1d2c7a-4e6f-4a90-9c11-3d5b8e2f7c44
status: experimental
description: Detects creation or modification of inbox/forwarding rules consistent with Kimsuky/TA427 covert email exfiltration after account takeover.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1114.003
  - attack.t1114.002
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: exchange
detection:
  selection_op:
    Operation:
      - 'New-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-Mailbox'
  selection_params:
    Parameters|contains:
      - 'ForwardTo'
      - 'ForwardAsAttachmentTo'
      - 'RedirectTo'
      - 'DeleteMessage'
      - 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
  condition: selection_op and selection_params
falsepositives:
  - Users legitimately configuring forwarding to a personal/secondary mailbox
level: medium
ucs.rationale: Kimsuky/TA427 is one of the few state actors whose primary objective is sustained reading of victim email rather than ransomware or destructive impact; mailbox-forwarding-rule creation is the on-objective action repeatedly documented against think-tank and NK-expert targets.
